Entry Obsidian Obsidian is a volcanic glass that is sharp and brittle and is commonly found in volcanic areas such as Dragonstone. Bachelors will study it as a mineral, craftsmen will make it into utensils, and northern stories will give it a special meaning against cold foreign objects; the same stone will have different values ​​​​in different hands. A past war or a dynastic change will determine today's tax rates, covenants, roads and who has the right to speak first in the hall.

Entry Obsidian Obsidian is a volcanic glass that is sharp and brittle and is commonly found in volcanic areas such as Dragonstone. Bachelors will study it as a mineral, craftsmen will make it into utensils, and northern stories will give it a special meaning against cold foreign objects; the same stone will have different values ​​​​in different hands. They remember which flag fell, which bridge was burned, and who shared the last sip of water in the snow; for them, history is first and foremost the memory left by the body.
